definitions.gloss: to stand frozen; to be rooted to the spot
definitions.explanation: To stand motionless, unable to move, due to fear, shock, or overwhelming emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{立|た}ちすくんだ。
⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ちすくんだ。
examples.english: I froze in place at the sudden loud noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れて→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧、{立|た}ちすくむしかなかった。
examples.english: A bear appeared right in front of me, and all I could do was stand frozen.

notes:
{立|た}ちすくむ describes standing motionless, unable to move, typically due to fear, shock, or overwhelming emotion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

FORMS:
⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) + ⟦すくむ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧ (to cower, to stiffen). The verb ⟦すくむ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧ means to become rigid or paralyzed.

ASPECT (ている):
{立|た}ちすくんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is standing frozen" — a continuing state of paralysis.

USAGE:
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{立|た}ちすくむ: to freeze with fear
- ⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{立|た}ちすくむ: to stand frozen in shock
- ⟦{圧倒|あっとう}されて→圧倒される：15413_attousareru⟧{立|た}ちすくむ: to be rooted to the spot in awe

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{足|あし}がすくむ→足がすくむ：18703_ashigasukumu⟧: legs freeze (with fear)
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すくむ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧: body freezes up
- ⟦{動|うご}けなく→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become unable to move
